g.text: R6: PIP supply RC filter R104/C83; Q25 bypasses R104 for P3V3 mode.

g.desc: R6: PIP supply RC filter R104/C83; Q25 bypasses R104 for P3V3 mode.

g.text: C75/C76 = 4.7 nF C0G: 48 kHz population; validate SAR settling before release.

g.desc: C75/C76 = 4.7 nF C0G: 48 kHz population; validate SAR settling before release.

g.text: Data clocked out when FSYNC (==LRCLK) is low

g.desc: Data clocked out when FSYNC (==LRCLK) is low

g.text: Glue logic to convert Left-Justified format into Convert/SPI signals for driving the ADC

g.desc: Glue logic to convert Left-Justified format into Convert/SPI signals for driving the ADC

g.text: Note Left-Justified differs very slightly from I2S - there's an extra bit somewhere in an I2S transaction.

g.desc: Note Left-Justified differs very slightly from I2S - there's an extra bit somewhere in an I2S transaction.

g.text: In P3V3 mode, 3.3VA is supplied to the IN_VUSB_5V pin of the input

g.desc: In P3V3 mode, 3.3VA is supplied to the IN_VUSB_5V pin of the input

g.text: connector, since we have no pins left, and this pin is generally

g.desc: connector, since we have no pins left, and this pin is generally

g.text: available when the product is deployed.

g.desc: available when the product is deployed.

g.text: The back-to-back FETs prevent the 5V USB supply back-feeding the +3.3VA rail.

g.desc: The back-to-back FETs prevent the 5V USB supply back-feeding the +3.3VA rail.

g.text: U36 detects 5V USB presence and disables 3.3V phantom even if P3V3_EN is asserted.

g.desc: U36 detects 5V USB presence and disables 3.3V phantom even if P3V3_EN is asserted.

g.text: This supply mode is required by the US-D ultrasonic mic.

g.desc: This supply mode is required by the US-D ultrasonic mic.

g.text: Self. D, Small Circuit Audio Design p. 505

g.desc: Self. D, Small Circuit Audio Design p. 505
